Find the hits in common between methods

Source: R/find_common_hit.R
find_common_hit.Rd

Returns the genes found as hits by at least common_in of the given methods. The results can come from any hit-finding method of ScreenR, and from any number of methods. To combine the methods using their FDR, see summarise_hits; to plot the overlap, see plot_common_hit.

Usage

find_common_hit(..., common_in = NULL, fdr = NULL)

Arguments

...

The results of the methods: gene-level tables with a Gene column (for example from find_gene_zscore_hit, find_camera_hit, find_roast_hit, find_time_hit or find_zscore_hit) or vectors of gene names, optionally named; or a single named list of them.

common_in

The minimum number of methods in which a gene has to be found. By default (NULL) all the methods.

fdr

An optional FDR threshold: the genes of the results with an FDR column are kept only when their FDR is at most fdr (useful for results computed with fdr = 1). By default (NULL) all the genes of each result are used.

Value

A character vector with the names of the common hits, ordered by the number of methods that find them.

See also

plot_common_hit, summarise_hits

Examples

hit_zscore <- data.frame(Gene = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"))
hit_camera <- data.frame(Gene = c("A", "B", "C", "F", "H", "G"))
hit_roast <- data.frame(Gene = c("A", "L", "N"))

# Common to all the three methods
find_common_hit(hit_zscore, hit_camera, hit_roast)
#> [1] "A"

# Common to at least two of the three methods
find_common_hit(hit_zscore, hit_camera, hit_roast, common_in = 2)
#> [1] "A" "B" "C"

# Any number of methods, filtered on their FDR
results <- list(
    FRY = data.frame(Gene = c("A", "B", "C"), FDR = c(0.01, 0.02, 0.3)),
    CAMERA = data.frame(Gene = c("A", "C"), FDR = c(0.04, 0.01)),
    Zscore = c("A", "B"),
    ROAST = data.frame(Gene = c("A", "B"), FDR = c(0.01, 0.6))
)
find_common_hit(results, common_in = 3, fdr = 0.05)
#> [1] "A"
